values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

note: Rustic campground between Town Corner Lake and the Black River in the Pigeon River Country State Forest, 18 miles east of Vanderbilt via East Sturgeon Valley Road, with easy access to the High Country Pathway. Gravel ramp onto Town Corner Lake (bass, bluegill); the Black River is half a mile east and the Blue Lakes 4 miles north. Remote, no cell service. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 12 sites 'for tent and small trailer use' (standard wording, silent on length) (all confirmed, derived -> manual); 15-day max new. Season changed: derived 'not year-round' -> year-round (table 'open all year'; roads may not be plowed). Type 'rustic', not equestrian or an ORV camp (ORV 'no'). Directions carry no road warning. The amenity table names it 'Town Corner State Forest Campground'; the page heading is 'Town Corner Lake State Forest Campground' (entry name kept). Note trimmed of field restatements and the contradicted 'Open ~April-October' and '~$15-20/night'.
